CUB_200_2011.role: MaxBoxAccV2 (Choe et al. CVPR 2020 WSOL benchmark)

VOC2012.role: pointing game (boxes on det-val; per-class masks + PxAP on seg-val)

COCO_val2017.role: pointing game + PxAP on instance masks (RISE / D-RISE protocol)

OpenImages30k.reason: clovaai/wsolevaluation distributes it only through OneDrive / Google Drive consent pages (prepare_openimages.sh points at onedrive.live.com/download?cid=B7111B95B80CCC66...).  A direct GET returns HTTP 403 with an HTML consent page, and the OpenImages V5 originals would have to be re-cropped with their metadata to reconstruct the benchmark.  SKIPPED, as instructed, rather than approximated.

ILSVRC2012_val_boxes.reason: the project ImageNet mirror (data/in1k) is the ungated HuggingFace `evanarlian/imagenet_1k_resized_256` re-encode, which discards the original ILSVRC2012_val_%08d filenames and reorders images inside each class directory.  The bbox XMLs are keyed by those filenames, so they cannot be joined to the mirror without re-downloading the gated original val set.  SKIPPED rather than guessed.
